label: Four source units exist only for the lane and can be deleted whole: lib/scorer/lanes/semantic-shadow.ts (465 lines), the lib/embedders directory (shims re-exporting @spec-kit/shared/embeddings, schema.ts, embeddings-health.ts, barrel, READMEs), the tracked lib/shared/embeddings symlink with its tsconfig.build.json excludes at lines 27-28, and scripts/measure-embedder-cost.mjs.

Sixteen mixed source files need line-level edits: advisor-server.ts (23, 26, 398-411, 444-464), watcher.ts (15, 496-515), skill-graph/scan.ts (7, 54, 67), advisor-recommend.ts (28-30, 110-126, 601-618), advisor-status.ts (19-32, 57, 136-137, 151-251, 392-420, 538, 562, 579-584), advisor-tool-schemas.ts (243+, 385-386, 395+, 459-460), tools/advisor-status.ts (16-17), skill-advisor-cli-manifest.ts (87-88), scorer/types.ts (84-99, 113-114), projection.ts (14, 16, 25-26, 768-779, 1390-1690, 1743, 1762-1763), skill-graph-db.ts (20-25, 40, 107-138, 726-816, 1297-1920), weights-config.ts 18, graph-causal.ts 88, metrics.ts 666, prompt-policy.ts 265, command-attach.ts 97 and 166.

The lane is one row at lane-registry.ts:13; ScorerLaneId, SCORER_LANE_IDS, AdvisorLaneSchema (advisor-tool-schemas.ts:21) and the status laneWeights record derive from it, so removal changes the tool output from five lane keys to four and every Record<ScorerLane, number> literal (fusion.ts:197-205, test fixtures) must drop the key. Fusion also carries the flag-gated exact semantic rerank (77-80, 169-172, 396-412, 1450-1459) and a command meaning path (869-881, 908-948, 1098+, 1622, 1635) that accepts only real cosine evidence from the lane and becomes dead code. Live weights sum to 0.95 either way; shadow weights drop from 1.00 to 0.95.

Schema objects: vec_metadata (skill-graph-db.ts:262, embedders/schema.ts:86), per-dimension vec_<dim> and vec_cmd_<dim> tables with _model and _hash indexes (schema.ts:71, 81, 126-127, 147-148), and a legacy inline store on skill_nodes (columns embedding, embedding_model_id, embedding_content_hash at skill-graph-db.ts:235-237, migration 398-405, indexes 408-409, rebuild copy 438-456). SCHEMA_VERSION is 1 and no code drops a vector table, so deleting the code leaves the objects on every existing database. The live database on this machine holds vec_metadata (pointer nomic-embed-text-v1.5, 768, ollama), vec_768 (15 rows), vec_cmd_768 (47 rows), an orphan vec_1024, and a .bak pre-rebuild copy sits beside it.

Launcher: the child-env allowlist forwards OLLAMA_BASE_URL, OLLAMA_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS and SYSTEM_SKILL_ADVISOR_EMBED_REFRESH (system-skill-advisor-launcher.cjs:184-188, test launcher-threshold-env.vitest.ts:22-39). Beyond the starting inventory, the same launcher supervises a HuggingFace model server (21, 30-32, 104-113, allowlist 180-183, 347-348, 529, section 1115-1310, 1668, 1701, 1739, 1800-1804) built from hf-model-server.cjs and lib/model-server-supervision.cjs, with files in /tmp/system-hf-embed. SKILL_ADVISOR_DISABLE_BUILTIN_SEMANTIC (163) has writers and no reader in a grep of .skilled.

Tests: 20 files are dedicated to the lane (tests/embedders/*, daemon/watcher-embedding-refresh, handlers/semantic-outage-degraded, scorer/semantic-shadow-ablation, semantic-shadow-cosine, semantic-lane-promotion, projection-embedding-staleness, fixtures/seed-skill-embeddings plus .embeddings-cache, semantic-lane-weight-zero, semantic-prompt-embedding-degrade, skill-graph-embedding-outage, skill-graph/embedding-coverage, refresh-in-background, refresh-roundtrip). Three need a body read (scorer/lane-weight-sweep, scorer/conflict-query-rerank, command-meaning-anchor). About 30 more need line edits for lane-key fixtures, status and scan contract fields, launcher env and schema DDL fixtures.

Scripts and generated artifacts: derive-command-bridges.cjs emits an embeddingText field (690-693, 1353) and the tracked command-bridges.generated.json carries 47 of them; capture-command-routing-baseline.mjs has a --real-embedding mode (27, 38, 68, 103-105, 141-198, 405-423, 491-492, 796-808); run-command-behaviour.mjs:1014 lists the OLLAMA_ prefix; the embedder command row lives in skill_advisor.py:2737-2740 and scoring-compatibility.json:266-268 and 611-613.

Build wiring: the advisor keeps @spec-kit/shared for RRF fusion, the IPC socket server and frontmatter parsing (fusion.ts:9, ipc/socket-server.ts:16, doc-frontmatter.ts:16), so only the embeddings subpath is cut. runtime/dist has zero tracked files, so compiled lane modules persist on every machine until a clean rebuild and the residue check must cover dist.

A residue check must match vector tables by pattern (vec_[0-9]*, vec_cmd_[0-9]*, vec_metadata) and not by the 768 dimension, because the code creates one table per dimension and this machine already holds vec_1024.
Removing the code never removes database objects: all DDL is CREATE IF NOT EXISTS and SCHEMA_VERSION only moves up, so existing databases need an explicit drop step or a rebuild.
Live skill-graph.sqlite holds vec_1024 in addition to the three tables named in the strategy's Known Context.
An untracked skill-graph.sqlite.pre-doctor-skill-advisor-rebuild.20261028152419.bak (471040 bytes) sits in runtime/database; contents not opened.
SKILL_ADVISOR_DISABLE_BUILTIN_SEMANTIC has no reader in a grep of .skilled excluding docs, JSON, dist and node_modules.
